$comment: Withholding tax on compensation tables effective Jan 1, 2023 (RR 11-2018 as amended; BIR revised withholding tax tables). Each bracket: floor (compensation exceeds), base tax, rate on excess over floor.

legalBasis: RR 11-2018 Annex E (Revised Withholding Tax Table effective Jan 1, 2023)
NIRC Sec 24(A)(2)(a) & Sec 79, as amended by RA 10963
tables.notes: Confirmed unchanged through Aug 2026 (no 2024-2026 issuance revised Annex E) and matched against multiple independent sources, including a worked example (₱50,000/mo → ₱1,875 + 20% × ₱16,667 = ₱5,208.40). Withholding applies to taxable compensation after mandatory SSS/PhilHealth/Pag-IBIG employee shares and non-taxable benefits. Pending House/Senate bracket bills would change these tables if enacted (TY2027 earliest).

items.benefit: Employee achievement awards (cash/GC allowed since RR 4-2025)

items.ceiling: 30% of regional basic minimum wage per day

legalBasis: RR 4-2025 (effective Feb 14, 2025: uniform allowance to ₱7,000; cash/GC achievement awards allowed)
deMinimis.notes: RR 29-2025 raised EVERY capped item effective Jan 6, 2026: VL monetization 10→12 days, dependents' medical cash ₱1,500→₱2,000/semester, rice ₱2,000→₱2,500, uniforms ₱7,000→₱8,000 (RR 4-2025 had taken it ₱6,000→₱7,000 in Feb 2025), actual medical ₱10,000→₱12,000, laundry ₱300→₱400, awards ₱10,000→₱12,000 (cash/GC allowed since RR 4-2025), gifts ₱5,000→₱6,000, meal allowance 25%→30%, CBA/productivity ₱10,000→₱12,000. Apply the old ceilings to pre-2026 payroll periods. Amounts within ceilings are tax-free; the excess counts toward the ₱90,000 other-benefits cap.

legalBasis: Wage Order NCR-26 (₱695 non-agriculture, in force since July 18, 2025, the last uncontested rate)
Wage Order NCR-27 (₱755/₱780 in two tranches; implementation ENJOINED by Pasig RTC: status quo ante Jul 24, TRO Jul 30, preliminary injunction Aug 13, 2026)
minimumWageReference.notes: NCR-27's ₱85 increase is judicially frozen as of Aug 26, 2026; DOLE's motion for reconsideration (filed Aug 17) is pending, so the operative NCR floor for minimum-wage-earner exemption purposes remains NCR-26's ₱695 (₱658 agriculture/small retail). Region-specific: every region has its own wage order; check your RTWPB's current order and the litigation's outcome.

value.method: graduated table on annualized taxable compensation; December adjustment trues up the year

legalBasis: RR 2-98 Sec 2.79(B)(5)(b), as amended by RR 11-2018
annualization.notes: On the last payroll of the year (or on termination), the employer computes tax on the full year's taxable compensation (including pay from a previous employer within the year) using the annual graduated table, and withholds or refunds the difference so total withheld equals annual tax due. Refunds of over-withholding are due to employees not later than January 25 of the following year.

legalBasis: Owner decision 3, Oct 7, 2026 (REVIEW.md 4.3); the rounding instruction on BIR Forms 1601-C and 2316 was not confirmed
payslipRounding.notes: Payslip, withholding and contribution lines are rounded half-up to the centavo (₱3.195 -> ₱3.20), computed exactly in whole centavos, and 12-month totals are 12 × the rounded monthly figure. Confirm against the current 1601-C and 2316 instructions.

legalBasis: NIRC Sec 24(A)(2), as amended by RA 9504
mweExempt.notes: Statutory minimum wage earners are exempt from income tax on their SMW, plus holiday pay, overtime, night differential, and hazard pay; no withholding applies.
